title: Mesa's NVK NVIDIA Driver Another Step Closer To Vulkan Ray-Tracing
extract: Mesa's open-source NVIDIA Vulkan driver has merged initial Tree Traversal Unit instruction handling, another step toward support for Vulkan ray-query and ray-tracing pipeline extensions.

title: Cisco and OpenAI pitch eBPF kernel plugins as the way to tame the patchpocalypse
extract: Cisco and OpenAI have released Shirudo, an open-source eBPF tool for applying Linux compensating controls when patches cannot be deployed quickly. The proposal includes AI agents scanning infrastructure and generating controls as eBPF programs.

title: Anthropic says Claude solved an age-old math problem, but the written proof is 250,000 pages of slop
extract: An Anthropic researcher claims Claude helped produce a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, but the enormous output has not been independently verified. The story highlights the challenge of checking and understanding AI-generated mathematical proofs.

title: Zstd 1.6 Released With Many Fixes, New Performance Optimizations
extract: Zstandard 1.6 brings faster AArch64 decompression, SVE2 compression and RISC-V vector optimizations, alongside fixes for multithreaded compression, 32-bit operation and potential memory-corruption issues.

title: Lucy Worsley’s Keys to the Castle review – heavenly TV that instantly brightens up your day
extract: The historian's new series tours Europe's great castles, opening at Venice's Doge's Palace; the review praises its accessible, upbeat approach to history.

title: Amazon scoops up AI accelerator tech to keep chips busy at all times
extract: Amazon is acquiring Decart AI's optimization technology and engineering team to improve utilization across Nvidia GPUs, Google TPUs and AWS Trainium, targeting faster inference and more efficient compute.

title: Ladybird Web Browser/Engine Reaches Alpha
extract: The independent browser and web engine has reached its first alpha after four years of development. Linux and macOS builds are available, although compatibility and stability remain firmly at an early stage.

title: Mesa 27.0 RadeonSI Gallium3D Disables Radeon Kernel Driver Support By Default
extract: Mesa 27.0 disables legacy Radeon kernel-driver compatibility by default for early GCN 1.0 and 1.1 GPUs, encouraging migration to AMDGPU. A temporary environment-variable override remains available.

title: Steven Spielberg to make a western written by Paul Thomas Anderson
extract: Spielberg is reportedly adapting Kevin Barry's 2024 novel The Heart in Winter as a western scripted by Paul Thomas Anderson, with Jessie Buckley, Cillian Murphy and Mark Rylance attached.

title: Critical Cisco remote code execution bug under attack
extract: CVE-2026-76466 in clustered Cisco Expressway gateways is being exploited. The unauthenticated flaw can allow root command execution, and a public proof of concept has increased the urgency for administrators of affected deployments.

title: AMD EPYC Zen 6 vs. Zen 1 Performance: 12.1x Geo Mean In Less Than 10 Years, Up To 133x In AI
extract: A decade-spanning benchmark compares the original 2017 Zen 1 EPYC 7601 with Zen 6 EPYC 9686F and 9996 systems, measuring a 12.1x geometric-mean gain and up to 133x in an AI face-detection workload.

title: Microsoft mega outage: Report reveals testing gaps and emails that never arrived
extract: Microsoft's final post-incident report says a Windows defect introduced by a July change disrupted Exchange Online and other Microsoft 365 services in November. Some emails never arrived, and the report identifies gaps in testing, auditing and recovery procedures.

title: Stellantis confirms closure of WEC, Formula E programs
extract: Peugeot is withdrawing from the WEC Hypercar class with immediate effect, while Stellantis will wind down its Citroën and Opel Formula E programmes after the coming season. The reshuffle matters to a WEC grid that includes Aston Martin, BMW and Ferrari, with McLaren and Ford preparing to join.

title: Firefox 161 Brings Per-Site VPN Toggling, Classic Themes Section
extract: Firefox 161 adds per-site VPN toggling and a classic-themes section, alongside developer-facing CSS improvements including the random() function and Typed Object Model support.

title: Dylan Moran goes looking for trouble and disappears off the beaten track in this baffling comedy show
extract: The Black Books comedian's new touring show opens with philosophical observations on humanity in 2026, then wanders into unfinished songs and a bewildering ending; the reviewer still finds flashes of trademark brilliance.

title: XNU Linux Lets macOS Userspace Processes Run On Linux
extract: The ARM64 project loads Apple's open-source XNU kernel as a Linux module so macOS user-space processes can run alongside Linux processes without a hypervisor. Its developers have reached a macOS 27 desktop environment.

title: LibreOffice 27.2 Alpha 1 Released For Testing
extract: The first LibreOffice 27.2 alpha previews JPEG XL image support, dynamic arrays in Calc, chart improvements and interface refinements ahead of the planned February release.

title: Norway links energy firm cyberattacks to critical Azure API Management flaw
extract: Norway's security authority says energy firms were affected by attacks exploiting a flaw in Azure API Management Classic. Microsoft has applied a mitigation, but customers are urged to investigate possible compromise and rotate exposed secrets; APIM v2 is not affected.

title: VKD3D 2.2 Released With More Improvements For Direct3D 12 On Vulkan
extract: The Direct3D 12-on-Vulkan implementation adds Shader Model 6.2 support, Vulkan shader float controls and HLSL/compiler improvements, helping modern Windows games and applications run through Wine.

title: Mesa 27.0 Merges LLVMpipe AVX-512 Support
extract: AVX-512 support for Mesa's LLVMpipe software OpenGL driver has finally merged into Mesa 27.0. AI coding assistance helped complete work that had stalled for years, although no performance measurements are available yet.

title: Old-school Linux desktops find fresh routes to Wayland
extract: Xfce 4.22 is taking shape for early 2027 with its own Wayland compositor, while MATE gains an Ubuntu-based Wayland desktop and a new compositor called Polo.

title: Airbus may be leaving Microsoft Office, but for its 36,000 defense staff, Office isn't leaving them
extract: Airbus expects to finish moving most of its workforce from Microsoft Office to Google Workspace within two to three years. Roughly 36,000 defence staff will remain on-premises because their sensitive work cannot move to cloud office suites.

title: Bill Wyman’s Rock & Roll Lists review – greatest hits and biggest misses
extract: The author is the veteran US rock critic, not the Rolling Stones bassist; his book turns decades of music history into obsessive rankings and lists, from the NME's early charts to later rock and pop.

title: MorphOS: Bluetooth stack MBlue 1.1 adds Windows file transfers
extract: An update posted on November 23 says MBlue 1.1 now supports copying files to and from Windows PCs, extending the native MorphOS Bluetooth stack's keyboard, mouse, audio and phone-transfer features.

title: Adder Stone by Clare Clark review – the story of a drowned Welsh village
extract: Clare Clark's historical novel revisits a Welsh village forcibly cleared to make way for Liverpool's reservoir, using the 1976 drought's exposed ruins to explore family relationships, female liberation and Welsh independence.

title: The Boy and the Suit of Lights review – a sensitive portrait of an aspiring toreador in a changing Spain
extract: This documentary follows a teenage aspiring toreador in Castellón as his family hopes bullfighting can lift them out of poverty while protests against the tradition grow.

title: AmigaOS 4: First beta version 0.9 of the web browser Quasar
extract: The native WebKit browser has its first public beta for AmigaOS 4.1, with separate builds for AmigaOne X5000 and G4-class systems. WebGL works, but WebAssembly and encrypted password storage are not yet available.

title: Classic in HD: Flashback - Port of 25th Anniversary Edition (AGA/RTG)
extract: A new Amiga port based on the 25th Anniversary Edition runs on A1200 AGA or RTG systems, with smoothed or re-rendered HD backgrounds, higher-resolution cutscenes and panoramic stereo sound effects.

title: Google claims last week’s critical VMware bug was under attack in September
extract: Google's Mandiant says a China-linked group exploited CVE-2026-123890 in VMware vCenter months before disclosure, using custom malware to forge authentication tokens, bypass MFA and investigate ESXi environments.

title: The Witch Farm review – this creepy tale is laugh-out-loud funny … without meaning to be
extract: Danny Robins dramatises the 1989 Heol Fanog haunting at a Welsh farmhouse; the BBC series is deliberately over-the-top, mixing paranormal horror with moments of unintentional comedy.

title: AmigaOS 4: Enabling audio recording on the A1222+
extract: A user-created utility works around broken Line-In and Mic-In recording controls in the A1222+'s audio mixer preferences, enabling audio recording on the system.

title: AMD Preps More Graphics Driver Fixes For Linux 7.5, More DCN6 Enablement
extract: AMD's next Linux 7.5 graphics and compute patch batch includes Display Core Next 6 work for RDNA 5, HDCP enablement and fixes around HDMI 2.1 and variable refresh rate support.

title: Code editor for AROS: Pragtical 3.14.0 in development
extract: A new AROS port of the Pragtical code editor is being prepared. The current package still lacks network functions and a plugin manager, but extends the editor to a seventh AROS package.

title: CachyOS November 2026 Released With EAC Linux v2 Support, New Recovery Tool
extract: The Arch-based distribution's November ISO refresh adds Easy Anti-Cheat Linux v2 support, a new recovery environment and a Windows Subsystem for Linux image, alongside the Package Installer 2.0 and driver improvements.

title: Intel Coral Rapids & Razor Lake Model IDs Submitted For Linux 7.4-rc4
extract: Linux kernel x86 fixes add model identifiers for upcoming Coral Rapids server and Razor Lake client processors, laying groundwork for dependent driver support ahead of their expected 2028 arrival.

title: Linux 7.5 To Introduce Initial Mainline Support For Ambarella SoCs
extract: Linux 7.5 is set to gain initial mainline support for Ambarella's CV75 computer-vision SoC and its developer board. The 5nm Arm chip targets edge AI, image processing and low-power video applications in areas including drones, robotics and automotive systems.

title: PSR2 & Panel Replay + Pipe Joiner To Be Supported For Intel On Linux 7.5
extract: Intel's Linux 7.5 display-driver patches enable Panel Replay and Panel Self Refresh 2 when multiple display pipes are joined, extending power-saving behaviour to more demanding eDP and DisplayPort configurations.

title: The First Rust WMI Linux Driver Being Developed Is For Clevo Laptops
extract: A new Rust-based WMI driver for Clevo laptops starts with keyboard-backlight control and is intended to exercise the Linux kernel's Rust WMI abstractions before broader laptop functionality is added.

title: WHDLoad: New installers until 21.11.2026
extract: The latest WHDLoad batch adds a SimCity save-game fix and CDDA support for the CDTV version, plus Super Mario Bros and Z-Out installer improvements, helping preserve floppy-era Amiga games for hard-disk use.

title: Boulder Dash clone: Bloody Rocks
extract: A playable demo is available with 17 levels, three deathmatch arenas and four characters; the full game is planned for December 4. It runs on an Amiga 500 with 1 MB of RAM and includes cross-platform online duels.

title: Operation Backstab: Demo version released
extract: The Spy vs. Spy-inspired Amiga game now has a demo covering its first three levels in single-player mode, with AGA and OCS versions; the intro, cutscenes and further levels are still in progress.

title: Kickstarter campaign for Revolution Joystick announced
extract: After six years of development and more than 100 prototypes, the multi-platform retro joystick is set for a December 1 Kickstarter, with three action buttons, adjustable autofire and Basic or handcrafted Premium editions.

title: QEMU frontend for running AmigaOS 4/MorphOS/AROS: Kyvos 2.3.0
extract: The QEMU frontend adds support for MorphOS 3.21 and interface improvements, including automatic mouse capture when the GTK renderer is used.

title: AmigaKit: USB Adapter for joysticks
extract: The A1200 Dual 9-pin Joystick to USB Adapter will connect two classic joysticks to a modern USB host; AmigaKit lists availability from December 4.
